ideas.pitch: A predictive AI simulation tool built for Mission 01 (The fireline) that models real-time wildfire spread across dense Nilgiri forest topographies using weather data and vegetation density.
ideas.problem_statement: Mission 01 - The fireline: Predict the Unpredictable. Contain the Uncontrollable in forest ecosystems.
ideas.title: NilgiriGuard Wildfire Early Warning & Spread Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles Mission 01 with a high-stakes environmental focus, mirroring the winning approach of the Sacramento State AI Hackathon wildfire model while adapting it to local Nilgiri topography.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision pipeline that processes remote trail-camera feeds in Ooty to identify endangered endemic species and track human-wildlife conflict zones.
ideas.problem_statement: Forest Intelligence and Wildlife Technology challenges involving computer vision and advanced machine learning in the Nilgiris.
ideas.title: FaunaVision: Automated Wildlife Corridor Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages computer vision for high-impact local conservation, directly addressing the biodiversity preservation priorities of judges familiar with the Nilgiri landscape.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent simulation platform modeling the microclimate and hydrological health of Ooty's endangered Shola forests to predict environmental degradation risks.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent Simulation and Forest Intelligence challenges for transforming complex environmental problems.
ideas.title: EcoSim Shola: Forest Canopy Digital Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a digital twin and simulation framework similar to winning energy and battery monitoring hacks, translating complex ecological telemetry into an actionable dashboard for forest rangers.

ideas.pitch: A predictive water-quality monitoring dashboard that forecasts algal blooms and pollution risks in Ooty lake ecosystems using machine learning on sensor data.
ideas.problem_statement: Predictive AI and Advanced Machine Learning for real-world environmental challenges in the Nilgiris.
ideas.title: BioBloom Nilgiris: Aquatic Ecosystem Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses proven predictive pipelines from water-focused hackathon winners to deliver quantified early-warning metrics that appeal directly to environmental science judges.

ideas.pitch: An edge-deployable computer vision classification tool to detect non-biodegradable waste accumulation along trekking routes and sensitive wildlife zones in Ooty.
ideas.problem_statement: Wildlife Technology, Computer Vision, and Advanced Machine Learning in the Nilgiris.
ideas.title: TerraVision: Automated Forest Litter & Plastic Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware-ready waste classification patterns with urgent local ecological cleanup priorities, echoing the practical utility of winning smart-garbage classification systems.
